title: Analyze sflag Timeouts
description: [Verify Command] Retrieve and aggregate TensorCore sflag timeouts, SparseCore sflag timeouts, and SparseCore sequencer halts to identify stragglers and outlier PCs.
instruction: LOGS=$(gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.pod_name:"${workload_name}-" AND ("Wait timeout on sflag" OR "Sflag wait timeout" OR "halted unexpectedly" OR "halted prematurely")' --project ${project_id} --order=ASC --format="value(jsonPayload.message)"); echo "=== TensorCore sflag timeouts ==="; echo "$LOGS" --freshness=${freshness} | grep "Wait timeout on sflag" | grep -o "hlo: [^ ]*" | sort | uniq -c; echo "=== SparseCore sflag timeouts ==="; echo "$LOGS" | grep "Sflag wait timeout" | grep -o "op: [^ ]*" | sort | uniq -c; echo "=== SparseCore halts ==="; echo "$LOGS" | grep -o "tag:pc [^ ]*" | sort | uniq -c

freshness.description: gcloud log-read window. gcloud defaults to 1 day and returns an empty set with exit 0 for anything older, which reads as a real negative. Widen this to reach a historical incident.
